description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) governance scanner that fetches up to limit (1-20) recent Snapshot DAO proposals for space_id (e.g. arbitrumfoundation.eth, aavedao.eth, ens.eth) and extracts on-chain target addresses and calldata to spot hostile takeover payloads. Queries Snapshot GraphQL API by default, or falls back to deterministic offline fixtures when use_curated_offline=true or network fails. Returns JSON with space_id, proposals_count, proposals (id, title, target_address, calldata, value_wei, state), and recommendation.

limit.description: Maximum number of proposals to fetch (default: 3)

use_curated_offline.description: If true, returns verified realistic offline curated proposals without outbound network calls

name: scan_dao_proposals
